concerns.text: FR-018 requires applying a Bonferroni correction to RMSE and F1‑score across multiple classification thresholds. RMSE is a continuous error metric and does not arise from a hypothesis test; assigning a p‑value to it and then correcting with Bonferroni is statistically inappropriate. Similarly, reporting F1‑score across several arbitrary thresholds and treating each as an independent hypothesis test ignores the dependence between thresholds. This constitutes a methodological misuse of multiple‑testing correction, potentially leading to invalid inference.
